what: When a wide photo enters the screen, the clipped face opens from left to right over 1s (rounded corners kept) · from opens it from top · bottom · right, zoom sinks the inner photo along with it, and batch opens panels that arrived together like a wave in top · left order

options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom-=100px — brand top 80%
options.fade: If 1, opacity also goes 0→1 while opening (Brand dotted line)
options.from: The side where the cut surface starts to open: left (default — left to right) | right | top (top to bottom) | bottom (bottom to top)
options.zoom: Inner [data-fx-part="zoom"] sinks together to 1 at this multiple, default 1 (off) — Site 1.1
options.fade-dur: Opacity duration of fade (seconds), same as dur by default — fuji-gen 1.5
options.fade-ease: Opacity curve of fade, same as the default ease — Brand ease(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
options.zoom-dur: Duration (sec) of the zoom settling, default same as dur — fuji-gen 1.5
options.zoom-ease: zoom curve, same as the default ease — fuji-gen ease(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
options.zoom-delay: Extra seconds to delay only the zoom (added to delay), default 0 — fuji-gen .08
options.zoom-y: Like zoom, the inner part drops in from this % of its own height (negative means above), default 0 — −6 in the original
options.batch: When set, panels that entered the same frame are gathered top then left and delayed by this many seconds each (up to 6 panels), default off — Brand .04
options.fx:in: Event fired the moment the panel opens when a batch is given (detail.delay = Delay (s) — for floating labels outside the board with the same delay
